clause_extraction.method: pypdf extraction and in-memory numbered-clause heuristics

safety_and_provenance: Source text is retained separately from proposed interpretation.
All chunks require human verification before use as authoritative adjudication rules.
Waiting-period applicability, conditions and exceptions are retained as source-linked text.
No numeric threshold is inferred by this builder.
excluded_items.pdf is not chunked: it repeats List I of Annexure-A (ADR-0003).
Index only chunks with searchable=true; table row 12.5 contradicts clause 6.1 (ADR-0004).
source.document_date is the PDF's creation date; no document states a policy effective date (ADR-0004).
For final decisions, check the policy schedule, endorsements, coverage dates and version.
limitations: PDF text extraction may omit text embedded in images or complex layouts; inspect empty pages.
Clause-level heuristics may mislabel topics/conditions/exceptions and are not proof of meaning.
This output is a retrieval corpus, not an embedding index; embeddings and vector-store schema are downstream steps.
